text: Why did the writer not get off the bus at Woodford Green?
zh: 为什么作者没有在伍德福德格林下车？
zh_hant: 為什麼作者沒有在伍德福德格林下車？

text: I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.
zh: 我喜欢在乡间旅行，但不喜欢迷路。
zh_hant: 我喜歡在鄉間旅行，但不喜歡迷路。

text: I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected.
zh: 我最近去远足了一次，但这次行程比我预想的要长。
zh_hant: 我最近去遠足了一次，但這次行程比我預想的要長。

text: 'I'm going to Woodford Green,'
I said to the conductor as I got on the bus,
'but I don't know where it is.'
'I'll tell you where to get off.'
answered the conductor.
I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
zh: 我坐在公交车前面，以便好好欣赏乡村景色。
zh_hant: 我坐在公交車前面，以便好好欣賞鄉村景色。

text: After some time, the bus stopped.
zh: 过了一会儿，公交车停了下来。
zh_hant: 過了一會兒，公交車停了下來。

text: Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
zh: 我环顾四周，惊愕地发现车上只剩下我一个乘客了。
zh_hant: 我環顧四周，驚愕地發現車上只剩下我一個乘客了。

text: 'You'll have to get off here,' the conductor said.
zh: “你得在这儿下车了，”售票员说。
zh_hant: “你得在這兒下車了，”售票員說。

text: 'This is as far as we go.'
'Is this Woodford Green?'
I asked.
'Oh dear,' said the conductor suddenly.
'I forgot to put you off.'
'It doesn't matter,' I said.
'I'll get off here.'
'We're going back now,' said the conductor.
zh: “我们现在要返回了，”售票员说。
zh_hant: “我們現在要返回了，”售票員說。

text: 'Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus,' I answered.
zh: “好吧，那样的话，我宁愿留在车上，”我回答说。
zh_hant: “好吧，那樣的話，我寧願留在車上，”我回答說。
